verdict.rationale: Calendly's core product is exactly this: shareable booking links/pages showing live availability (synced across calendars) that invitees can pick from without email back-and-forth, corroborated by extensive docs (event types, embed pages, calendar sync/conflict checking) and strong community testimony confirming it eliminates scheduling ping-pong. Missing for 10: no first-party quantitative data on conversion/adoption beyond anecdotal community praise.
